descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B29 · P2 · 已知

养老院住户没有 Facility 字段：添加表单填不了，卡片不显示，也不能按它搜

票：TFA-92581 AC3 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-03/S10

思路 / Approach · TC-03 Search & Sort · S11 「Add Resident 表单要填养老院的身份字段」 Add Resident form asks for the Nursing Home identity fields

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U6 Nursing Home identity fields are name, unit/room, MRN and facility.（UAT TC-03）
  • U4 Nursing Home: search by name, by unit/room, by MRN and by facility each returns the correct matching residents, each field on its own.（UAT TC-03；TFA-92581 AC 3；TFA-92581 AC 6）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Standard fixture, Nursing Home context

When Open the Add Resident form (the + button on the Nursing Home list, or /snf/add) and look at it without saving

Then The form asks for name, unit/room and MRN, and for facility if facility is meant to be typed on add (Q1)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs: cp1 mustContain 'Full Name', 'Unit', 'MRN' (U6) and 'Facility'. 'Facility' is listed under knownGaps: it is judged only if Q1 says facility is typed on add; otherwise the item is dropped, and AC 3's facility Fail rests on S10. The form's full field list in the snapshot is recorded for Q2 (complete set vs minimum), not judged. …

在哪跑：dev 单元 U24；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S11 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：已知产品问题 · 环境 dev · 票 TFA-92581 ready for qa

养老院的 Add Resident 表单有姓名、出生日期、单元/房号和 MRN，但没有 Facility 字段。

The Nursing Home Add Resident form asks for name, date of birth, unit/room and MRN, but has no Facility field.

依据：dev U24 (ledger #24, re-judged Fail (known)). Already in dev report §4. It counts only if Q1 answers 'typed on add'; S10 carries the AC 3 facility Fail. Same root as TC-03/S10.

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
